The landed budget selector verified in a capped ordinary probe. The binder opened its 161-byte resource and reached URL.getPath. The formatter reached Class.getGenericInterfaces. Physical and native controls covered conflicting inverse writes, escaped order, colliding identity hashes, LinkedHashSet mutation, independent streams and a reversed pair of JARs. The pinned control passed and all 59 selected Rust binaries and seven Python suites passed. A timing-dependent solver stand-in passed in isolation and on the full rerun.
